root_cause: The OpenVINO Tokenizers build uses CMake FetchContent to download the sentencepiece v0.2.1 release tarball directly from github.com/google/sentencepiece/releases. The ARM64 merge-queue runner's outbound HTTPS request to that release-asset URL received an HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout from GitHub's edge (x-github-edge-region: sea), a transient upstream/CDN availability issue unrelated to the PR's doc-only changes (install-openvino.rst and the selector-tool static assets). Run attempt 2 of the same job completed successfully with no code changes, confirming the failure was a one-off network blip rather than a deterministic defect.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally since it depends on a transient GitHub release-asset CDN hiccup. To attempt: on an aarch64 Linux host, run `pip wheel ./src/bindings/python/tools/openvino_tokenizers` (or trigger the 'OpenVINO tokenizers extension' CI job) and observe the CMake FetchContent_Populate step fetching https://github.com/google/sentencepiece/releases/download/v0.2.1/sentencepiece-0.2.1.tar.gz; a transient 504 from GitHub during that window reproduces the failure.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'OpenVINO tokenizers extension' job (already succeeded on attempt 2); no code change needed.

Consider mirroring the sentencepiece release tarball (and other FetchContent-based third-party sources) through an internal artifact cache/proxy to reduce dependency on github.com release-asset CDN availability during merge-queue builds.

Consider adding retry/backoff to the CMake FetchContent download step (e.g., CMAKE_TLS_... retry wrapper or a pre-fetch script with retries) for third-party sources fetched directly from github.com releases.
prevention_strategies: Mirror or cache third-party FetchContent sources (sentencepiece, pcre2, etc.) in an internally controlled location, and/or wrap FetchContent downloads with automatic retry logic to absorb transient GitHub release-asset 5xx responses without failing the whole merge-queue run.
historical_context: A near-identical pattern was recorded on 2026-09-21 for the same job (OpenVINO tokenizers extension) downloading pcre2-10.48.zip from github.com and failing with HTTP 504 (pattern 2baab38e090720ec, PR #38190, run 35611487106). This is the second distinct third-party-download timeout observed for this job in about 10 days, suggesting github.com release-asset fetches from this job are a recurring soft spot even though each specific package/signature is new.
